title: Shearling Flyer Jacket - Navy Corduroy
body_html:
This is what happens when you take the concept of a classic bomber jacket, and you fill it with the soul of a surfer. A layer of shearling lines the wind-resistant shell, with quilting in the sleeves for warmth without bulkiness. The ribbed waist and cuffs lend a laid-back, collegial look, and the shearling collar adds to the jacket’s cozy comfort. At Battenwear, we like to think of our clothes as gear, and this jacket was made for navigating through the gloomiest winter weather into bright blue skies.

Fabric Note

Corduroy has a long history as a hard-wearing fabric used for workwear, outdoor clothing, and everyday garments. Battenwear is proud to use fabrics that get better with use and age, and corduroy is no exception. With repeated wear, the surface softens, the ridges develop subtle variations in texture and color, and the fabric takes on a character unique to its wearer. 

Fit & Features

  • relaxed fit
  • shearling lined torso and collar, quilting in sleeves
  • two-way YKK metal zipper
  • pleated cargo pockets (button flap closure) at waist, backed by vertical hand warming pockets
  • storage pocket inside at left chest

title: Northfield Parka V.2 - Olive 60/40
body_html:
The Northfield Parka was originally designed for a Los Angeles native who moved to Northfield, Minnesota and needed something serious to help survive the subzero winters. This isn’t your average coat. Beyond just being toasty warm, the Northfield Parka is packed with thoughtful details: fleeced lined hand-warming pockets, a brimmed hood with adjustable drawstring, and a mix of snap and Velcro closures to minimize glove-handed fumbling.

Inside at waist, an adjustable drawstring allows for a custom fit, while a foam-reinforced hood brim offers structure and protection against snow or rain. Simply put, this is our “you’re-not-in-California-anymore” parka—made for real cold-weather living.

Fabric Note

60/40 (60% Cotton / 40% Nylon) is substantial yet lightweight for its warmth. The material’s wind- and water-resistance come from its thread composition—not chemical coatings—resulting in durability, breathability, and comfort season after season.

Fit & Features

    • true to size (roomier than V.1)
    • wind- and water-resistant
    • side-entry hand-warming pockets lined with fleece
    • Velcro sleeve and chest pocket closures
    • raglan sleeves for freedom of movement
    • adjustable inner drawstring at waist for a custom fit
    • two-way YKK zipper with Battenwear-embossed leather pull

title: Do-Gi Pants - Black Moleskin
body_html:
These pants were inspired by martial arts uniforms, the sole purpose of which is to allow the greatest range of motion as well as durability for hard use and grappling. Just in case you haven’t spent much time on the judo or karate mat recently, “do-gi” roughly translates to “uniform for your path,” or clothes to wear as you train in your practice. Basically, we find that if pants meet the qualification to perform well in a dojo, then they are going to be supremely comfortable for outdoor activities and everyday use. It doesn’t hurt that they also look really cool. 

Fabric Note

Moleskin fabric has a long history in hunting and military use. A lighter-weight alternative to denim or canvas, cotton moleskin has a tight weave made of thick threads which results in high wind-resistance and durability. Despite the decidedly rugged nature of its exterior, the brushed, soft interior of the fabric makes it comfortable for long term wear. Battenwear is proud of using fabrics that get better with use and age, and we are excited to wear this military moleskin until it develops a fine patina.

Fit & Features

  • relaxed fit
  • angle entry hand pockets
  • button flap patch pockets on rear
  • adjustable nylon webbing built-in belt with Battenwear logo
  • zip fly with button at top
  • Battenwear embroidered patch at back right, above pocket
  • long diamond crotch gusset for superior range of movement

Vintage vibes, Canadian heritage, cozy feels . . . what's not to like?

The Battenwear Pocket-On Tee is a fresh take on the classic pocket T-shirt—simple, versatile, and full of subtle texture.

Made from soft, breathable 5.4-oz Cotton Jersey, it features a contrast Cotton Broadcloth pocket that’s garment-dyed together with the body, creating a distinctive bi-tonal look that sets it apart from the everyday tee.

Lightweight yet durable, it’s the kind of T-shirt you’ll want to live in all summer long.

• True to size
• Regular fit

DETAIL HIGHLIGHTS
• Garment dyed for a unique tone and texture
• Slight color contrast chest pocket
• Battenwear label to left of chest pocket

FABRIC & CONSTRUCTION
• Fabric: 5.4-oz Jersey (body) with Cotton Broadcloth (pocket)
• Contents: 100% Cotton
• Soft hand feel and breathable comfort
• Made in Japan

body_html:

title: Five Pocket Island Shirt - Orange Banana Leaf
body_html:
There’s no doubt that the traditional, ultra-cool four-pocket Cuban guayabera is comfortable and convenient for easy-access storage. And the Hawaiian shirt is the height of laid-back fun. The Battenwear Five-Pocket Island Shirt is the perfect marriage of the two.

The fifth pocket? We added this for early morning subway rides to New York's Rockaway Beach--it's just the right size for a metro card . . . and a $5 bill so you can get your cup of coffee and a snack from the bodega before hitting the waves.

Offered in crisp Cotton Dungaree, vibrant Indian Madras, and bold Printed Broad Cloth, this shirt blends effortless summer style with functional craftsmanship.

FIT
• True to size
• Boxy fit for relaxed comfort

DETAIL HIGHLIGHTS
• Two chest pockets
• Two waist pockets with a small fifth pocket inside the right waist pocket
• Battenwear label on side of left waist pocket
• Flat-felled seams for durability
• Square hem with side slits
• Slit detail at sleeve hems

FABRIC & CONSTRUCTION
• Fabric: Cotton Printed Broad Cloth 
• Contents: 100% Cotton
• Lightweight and breathable
• Reinforced seams for long-lasting wear
• Made in Japan

Inspired by the golden age of 1970s outdoor down coats, the Batten-Down Parka is a modern update to a timeless classic—built to offer warmth, durability, and refined style.

 

Like our Batten-Down Vest, the parka is produced at a military-grade factory in Japan, ensuring superior craftsmanship and meticulous attention to every detail.


The down undergoes a special cleaning process using mineral-rich Japanese water, which naturally removes impurities and enhances the “fluff effect”, making the parka exceptionally light, warm, and comfortable.

 

Favorite design elements include the detachable hood, angled hand pockets, and leather trim details—a perfect blend of function and sophistication.

Fit

  • True to size
  • Raglan sleeves
  • Adjustable draw cord with leather stopper at hood and inner waist

Utility Details

  • Wind-resistant and water-repellent
  • Horizontal quilting for optimal heat retention
  • Velcro flap waist pockets with side-entry hand-warming pockets behind
  • Two-way #10 VISLON® zipper with embossed Battenwear leather pull and snap cover flap
  • Detachable hood with snap fasteners

title: Battenwear x Nanga Eitherway Down Jacket / Purple x Red
body_html:
At Battenwear, we’ve got plenty of sempai brands—those outdoor pioneers who inspire our work every day. But then there are the grand-sempai brands, the true icons who defined what outdoor wear could be.


Nanga is one of those legends, and we’re incredibly proud to collaborate with them.

The Eitherway Down Jacket is a true transformer—more than meets the eye.
Start with an ultra-warm down jacket. When the sun comes out, zip off the hood. Feeling adventurous? Zip off the sleeves for a short-sleeve down top. It’s the kind of versatility that earns a permanent spot in our travel bag.

We used lightweight, water-repellent 30 Denier Ripstop Nylon, and added a mesh interior pocket so you can even use your body heat to dry wet gloves—because why not make your gear work smarter?

title: Beach Breaker / Sage
body_html:
Although inspired by classic college football windbreakers, the Beach Breaker was actually made in honor of intrepid East Coast surfers. For those who don't know: the only kind of surf we have near NYC comes from beach breaks, which means we spend a lot of early mornings standing on the cold sand, staring out at the horizon, and waiting for the wind to bring the waves in just right . . . before we commit to the wetsuit. The Battenwear Beach Breaker is the perfect standing-on-the-beach, staring-longingly jacket. It does not hurt that, while standing there, you kind of look like an old-school, bad-ass football coach.

Fabric note: We love this water repellent taslan nylon. Taslan is known for being quick-drying and having as soft a hand feel as cotton. This particular taslan also has a finely crinkled texture which prevents cling and  makes it well suited for hot days.

Fit:

  • raglan sleeve
  • model is 5'10" 180 lb, wearing size M

  • Single layer
  • Water repellent fabric
  • Plastic snap button front

  • Patch pocket on left chest with snap flap closure
  • adjustable cord at bottom hem
